description: This file declares the MediaFrameWriterFactory class, which implements the IMediaFrameWriterFactory interface. It provides a factory method to create IMediaFrameWriter instances, likely used for media frame writing in the Rialto media component.

classes.name: MediaFrameWriterFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating media frame writer instances, implementing the IMediaFrameWriterFactory interface.

methods.name: createFrameWriter
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique pointer to an IMediaFrameWriter, given a shared memory buffer and media player shared memory info.
